purpose: Test Arabic-language, Islamic, Persianate, and Jewish structures while preserving their overlapping Islamicate contexts and non-interchangeable identities.

packet_slots.position: Arabic translation movement, falsafa, demonstration, intellect, and classification of sciences
kalām reason/revelation, divine attributes, atomism, causation, and human action
Avicennan essence/existence, necessity/possibility, intellect, soul, and prophecy
Ghazālian critique, demonstration/dialectic, causation, choice, law, and spiritual practice
Averroist demonstration, interpretation, philosophy/religion, law, and political order
Illuminationist light, knowledge by presence, hierarchy, and philosophical practice
Ibn ʿArabī and related Sufi self-disclosure, unity/multiplicity, imagination, and transformation
Islamic and Persianate ethics, adab, virtue, justice, practical wisdom, and governance
rabbinic law, interpretive argument, textual plurality, practice, and communal authority
Saadya on reason/revelation, laws of reason/revelation, tradition, creation, and praxis
Maimonides on negative theology, demonstration, prophecy, law, perfection, and Islamicate sources
Judah Halevi on reason, historical revelation, embodied tradition, peoplehood, and exile
Spinoza on Scripture, interpretation, substance, freedom, political authority, and contested Jewish location
modern Jewish dialogical and alterity ethics, relation, responsibility, Scripture, diaspora, and politics

selection_rules: Arabic-language, Islamic, Islamicate, Persianate, Arab, Muslim, and Jewish name different scopes and are never synonyms.
Jewish authors writing Arabic in Islamicate settings may connect lanes without being absorbed into an Islamic identity.
Philosophy, theology, jurisprudence, commentary, mysticism, ethics, and religious practice remain distinct genres even when one author crosses them.
Greek-source transmission is recorded as translation and transformation, not passive copying or Western ownership.
No theological, legal, political, or mystical claim becomes Factorium guidance.
stop: Complete fourteen packets with Islamicate overlap and identity boundaries intact; hand immutable records and candidate mappings to GPC-09.
